writer_analysis.objective: Extend the existing generated multi-file Taskboard project with ONE feature: rename a task.
scope: Implement the rename feature through the existing CLI.
Preserve existing add/list/complete CLI behavior.
Preserve existing SQLite task data.
Preserve the existing multi-file module layout.
Preserve source-bundle packaging.
Add no new dependencies.
Provide the command interface: python -m taskboard --database PATH rename ID TITLE.
Ensure successful rename exits with code 0 and prints a specific JSON object.
Ensure that renaming only changes the title and preserves the task ID and completion state.
Ensure that the rename feature works on both open and completed tasks.
Ensure that the rename persists across processes and on databases created before this feature.
Ensure that repeating the same title succeeds identically.
Trim whitespace around the title and preserve internal spacing, case, Unicode, and SQL-like text literally.
Use parameterized SQL and close connections on success and missing-ID errors.
Ensure invalid operations do not change task data.
Ensure a missing task in a fresh database does not create a task.
Ensure separate databases remain isolated.
Ensure existing validation and behavior do not regress.
Implement through actual imports connecting the modules while preserving metadata and standard-library-only policy.
Add at least three meaningful unittest tests for rename success with persistence, completed-state preservation, and invalid-input/no-write behavior.
Retain the five existing tests, resulting in at least eight tests total.
Include CLI subprocess tests that assert success/output.
Ensure tests use temporary databases and run independently of factory files.
Update the README to explain rename syntax and behavior, including examples.
constraints: Do not add web UI, delete, search, users, or other features.
Do not edit independent factory adapters.
Passing baseline checks does not satisfy missing feature tests or documentation.
